source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: When a melee attack destroys a model here before it has fought in the phase, roll one D6 for that casualty. Add 1 if [Fortify Takeover](vsdata:ability/leagues-of-votann.prioritised-efficiency) applies to units from your army. A 4+ keeps the casualty in play. It may fight once the attacking unit finishes its attacks, then is removed.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 9 of 157 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.

trigger.event: each source-unit model destroyed by melee attack

modifier.if: units from your army have Fortify Takeover

success.timing: after attacker unit finishes its attacks
